verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Deel runs payroll for employees across 150+ countries. Nothing in the pack mentions direct deposit, next-day or 2-day deposit timing, or replacing checks, so generic payroll processing is only adjacent to this story. The community note about Deel Wallet concerns payout method terms, not deposit speed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pay employees by fast (next-day or 2-day) direct deposit instead of writing checks
